banned_anti_patterns.rule: Reconciliation evidence MUST NOT be manual spreadsheets or ad-hoc adjustments.
Contract MUST NOT contain TBD/TODO/WIP placeholders.
UUID strings MUST NOT be sorted for hashing/signature/tie-break; use 16-byte lexicographic sort.

errors.notes: NEW: proposed invariant — ERR-1 MUST add the above RECON_* subcodes to remain canonical.

producer_requirements.statement: Evidence producers (LED-1 rollups, BI-1 extracts, ORD-1 snapshots) MUST emit an artifact for every required evidence_kind for every scheduled window even when the value is zero. Absence of the artifact is classified as data_gap_missing_evidence.

retention_policy.requires_ARCH-1: NEW: proposed invariant — evidence retention tiers MUST be governed by ARCH-1 + DATA-1; until adopted, RECON evidence MUST be retained >= 400 days.

idempotency_hash_spec.notes: When hashing over lists of posting_ids/order_ids, normalize to 16-byte UUID and sort by unsigned byte order.

fx_policy.rule: FX MUST NOT be applied inside RECON-1. If multi-currency consolidation is required, a dedicated FX contract MUST be introduced and referenced.

invariants.statement: If a reconciled metric declares a currency dimension, all evidence sources participating in the join MUST use the same ISO 4217 currency code for the same org_id and window. If not, the variance MUST be classified as currency_mismatch and treated as payout/close blocking.

Any evidence artifact consumed by RECON-1 that includes lists of UUID identifiers (e.g., posting_ids, order_ids) MUST normalize each UUID to raw 16-byte form and sort by unsigned lexicographic byte order (ascending) before hashing/signing. Sorting UUID strings is forbidden.

join_keys_policies.notes: All financial reconciliations are per-org, per-currency, per-window.

missingness_rules.late_arriving_postings: Late postings within lag allowance MUST classify as timing_lag and trigger rerun; after deadline MUST classify as corruption_suspected.
missingness_rules.missing_evidence_vs_zero: Missing evidence artifact MUST classify as data_gap_missing_evidence; zero values MUST require an explicit evidence artifact with value=0.

alerting.incident_linkage: MUST link blocker alerts to incident_id if OBS-1 incident system is enabled.

audit_requirements.notes: Overrides document acceptance only and MUST NOT mutate ledger or snapshots.

two_person_rule.rule: One actor MUST propose override, a distinct actor MUST approve.

hard_bans: RECON-1 MUST NOT mutate ledger postings.
RECON-1 MUST NOT recompute or rewrite order or price snapshots.
RECON-1 MUST NOT accept manual spreadsheet adjustments as reconciliation evidence.

behavior.during_rebuild: Classify as expected_backfill and block close/payout.
behavior.post_rebuild: A post-rebuild reconciliation rerun MUST be triggered for all affected windows before close unlock.

rebuild_backfill_interaction.requires_DMSC-1: NEW: proposed invariant — a DMSC-1 controlled rebuild/backfill window MUST publish a rebuild_marker evidence artifact.

truth_alignment_definitions.ledger_bounded: MUST match within the referenced tolerance_policy; exceeding tolerance MUST classify as blocker unless override is applied.
truth_alignment_definitions.ledger_exact: MUST match LED-1 derived rollups exactly (0 tolerance) for the window and join domain.
truth_alignment_definitions.provider_matched: MUST match external provider statement AND reconcile back to LED-1; FORBIDDEN unless a provider_statement contract is a declared dependency.

admission_control.statement: Scheduled recon runs MUST apply jitter and MUST pass OBQC admission before attempting to acquire LOCKS-1 recon_window locks. If admission is denied, the run MUST backoff with exponential delay capped at 10 minutes.

concurrency_and_locking.lock_ordering: recon_window locks MUST be acquired after ledger_posting and before payout_run in the LOCKS-1 canonical order; until LOCKS-1 is patched to include recon_window, RECON-1 MUST NOT be deployed.

locking.statement: RECON-1 runs MUST acquire exclusive recon_window locks for their scope. Consumers that must not operate mid-reconciliation (e.g., payout pipelines) MUST acquire shared recon_window locks on the same scope before acquiring payout_run locks.

retry_posture.requires_DP-1: NEW: proposed invariant — async retry/backoff policy SHOULD be governed by DP-1; until adopted, retries MUST use exponential backoff with max 12 attempts.

run_identity.schema_rev: integer monotonically increasing for breaking changes

summary: Defines deterministic reconciliation runs, evidence requirements, variance taxonomy, adjudication workflow, and close/payout blockers that bridge BI-1 definitions with LED-1 financial truth.
title: RECON-1 — Reconciliation, Variance Classification, and Close Enforcement

classification_rules.corruption_suspected: Deltas exceed tolerance OR evidence contradicts immutable sources OR late arrival beyond deadline.
classification_rules.currency_mismatch: Join keys incompatible due to currency dimension mismatch between evidence sources; treated as configuration/data contract mismatch.
classification_rules.data_gap_missing_evidence: One or more required evidence artifacts missing.
classification_rules.expected_backfill: Run occurs during an approved rebuild/backfill window; close MUST be blocked.
classification_rules.manual_override_applied: Variance accepted by authorized override; remediation ticket MUST be created.
classification_rules.none: All joins match and deltas are zero.
classification_rules.provider_mismatch: External provider statement mismatch where provider_matched is enabled.
classification_rules.rounding: Deltas attributable to rounding policy only.
classification_rules.timing_lag: Deltas attributable to late-arriving evidence within lag allowance.
classification_rules.tolerance_ok: All joins match and deltas within tolerance.

notes: RECON-1 MUST NOT emit domain events unless EVT-1 defines and registers the event types; observability signals are governed by OBS-1.
